name: Jito Liquid Staking
description: JitoSOL is the first liquid staking derivative on Solana to include MEV rewards. Tracks the price of SOL while accruing staking and MEV rewards. Yield is accrued in the price so it will steadily appreciate vs. SOL

methodology.UserFees: Percentage of rewards paid to protocol
methodology.Fees: Fee accured to the jito DAO (Withdrawal Fees, Interceptor Fees, Tip Router Fees)
methodology.Revenue: Fee accured to the jito DAO (Withdrawal Fees, Interceptor Fees, Tip Router Fees)
